svg.aria-label: How to write ಯ: 4 strokes · 3 pen lifts · 7 movements
svg.title: Writing ಯ
svg.desc: 7 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ಯ (kannada), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansKannada-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ya.gif, animation of Kannada consonant ಯ, 35 frames, 3.5 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016) <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kannada-alphabet-ya.gif>. Source note on variation: The CC BY-SA 4.0 animation writes ಯ in four pen-down runs: the round bowl, counterclockwise from its upper left (frames 0–8); after a lift, a fresh stroke from the foot of the bowl that dips and climbs the middle arm to the top (frames 9–14); after a second lift, the top bar from left to right curling up into the hook (frames 15–18); after a third lift, the small right bowl from its foot, round its base and up its right side, curling in at the top (frames 19–24). The frames were read from a mirror copy that matches the Commons file's listed size (260×189, 116 KB) and byte size. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Kannada outline rather than copying the animation's handwritten proportions; in that outline the middle arm runs into the bar instead of curling over, so the arm ends at the bar, but the three-lift order remains the same.
svg.text: How it is written — 4 strokes · 3 pen lifts · 7 movements

text.tspan: and curl in at the top

svg.text: Stroke order after Gopala Krishna A, Kannada-alphabet-ya.gif, animation of Kannada consonant ಯ, 35 frames, 3.5 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 25 May 2016)
